zhx_ad_normalize = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_ad_initialized } }
     set_country_flag = zhx_ad_initialized
     set_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 0 }
     set_variable = { which = zhx_ad_selected value = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 0 } } }
     set_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 7 } }
     set_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 6 } }
    if = { limit = { OR = {
     NOT = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_selected value = 1 } }
     check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_selected value = 13 }
    } } set_variable = { which = zhx_ad_selected value = 1 } }
}

zhx_ad_refresh_viewers = {
    every_country = {
     limit = { ai = no has_country_flag = zhx_ad_initialized }
     zhx_ad_refresh = yes
    }
}

zhx_ad_open = {
    if = { limit = { zhx_ad_access = yes }
     zhx_ad_normalize = yes
     zhx_ad_refresh = yes
     set_country_flag = zhx_ad_visible
    }
}
